page.layout: One printed page: a single framed engraving in the centre (a man bound to a tree trunk with arms raised, a town and landscape behind, a sailing boat on the sea). No text inside the engraving. A library stamp in blue lies at the lower right, outside the text block.
page.notes: Engraving only: a man tied to a post or tree with raised arms, a building at left, hills, trees and a boat on water at right. No printed text is legible. The blue circular stamp (library ownership stamp, partly reading "NAPOLI" and "BIBLIOTECA") is not transcribed. Edge of the neighbouring page visible at the right margin and show-through are not transcribed.
